title: 第3章 蛇鼠一窝一家子反派第4章 命中注定影儿收心
lines: 包括先前那清秀女子在内，几乎所有的女弟子都痴迷地看向从神光之中走出的男子。
气质出尘，宛若仙人一般。
顾云的无上魅力光环在此刻发挥作用，这些女子就好像前世的那些见到了爱豆的追星女一般，爱意汹涌。
【叮！宿主完成反派行径——芳心纵火（lv5），获得反派值1000】
所谓一见顾云误终生，不知道有多少女子会因此丧失对男性的追求和欲望，顾云确实非常符合反派作风。
试想一下，这些女子日后见着自己的丈夫，时常会问，你比顾云神子如何？
想当初，我可是有幸观摩神子风采……不知又会影响多少家庭和谐，实在是罪孽深重。
这已经是顾云第五次触发这个成就了，仅仅依靠相貌他就已经祸害了一万名如花似玉、纯洁如纸的女修，实在是天底下的第一大罪人。
“太帅了……这简直太帅了，就好像是从画里面走出来的一样。”
“小芳，你掐一下我，看看我是不是在做梦？”
瞬时间，场中就变得吵吵嚷嚷的，无数女弟子惊呼尖叫，更有甚者，直接双腿一软，跪坐在了地上。
以往的男神偶像此刻都已经不值一提了，所有人的心中只剩下了一个坚定的信仰，那就是——神子殿下！
顾苍看着周围变得异样的众多族人，有些无奈，因为他自己此刻也有跪下来的冲动。
“这就是上界的神子吗？我和他相比，简直就是萤火比之皓月！”
先前的沾沾自喜在见到顾云这一刻就已经全部消弭。
虽然顾云没有展露修为，但是他身上的恐怖气势和磅礴威压，已经让在场所有的年轻人都丧失了比较的勇气，哪怕是顾苍也不例外，他的感受最为强烈，自己和顾云之间的差距，或者比自己和其他族中弟子的差距还要大上千倍百倍。
他本以为自己已经是天才了，今日才知，自己的认识是多么的浅薄。
“神子殿下大驾光临，下界贫瘠，无法为神子殿下举行最盛大欢迎仪式，还请神子殿下莫怪。”
顾家老祖缓缓走上前，恭恭敬敬的跪下，给顾云行礼。
“那是顾擎天老祖，五百年前就叱咤世间的合体大能。”
“连合体修士都卑躬屈膝，也只有上界的神子大人能有这样的待遇吧……”
无数弟子也都有样学样，老祖都跪了，他们这些弟子要是还站着，那算个什么事情？
“起身吧。”顾云淡淡道：“我所行之事，顾家可都知晓？”
本来，顾家之人下界时应当是要封印记忆，封印修为，使用下界的功法、下界的身份，凭借心中的执念，战胜一众敌人，最后炼化世界本源，突破合体，飞升上界。
但是——
在林家和无上神朝两方的共同施压下，顾家选择了妥协，就变成了现在的游历版本。
当然，这也是顾云的无上魅力光环的效果，不论是顾家、林家还是无上神朝三方势力都不希望顾云出事，只是……祖命不可违，最终还是保留了形式，走一个过场。
有关顾云前来的目的，龙城顾家自然也都知晓。
顾擎天缓缓道：“谨遵主家指示，一年前顾家就已经开始在苍玄界各处寻找，最终排查出了这三处地方的可能性最大！”
说着，他将一份地图递上。
其上有三处地点用灵力画了圈。
“此处名为无尽火山，其内部常年涌动神火，百万年来都未曾熄灭，是苍玄界火修常年流连之地，其内的力量极其适合火修修炼。”
“无数人传言，其中有踏入道宫的机遇所在，最近一次将在半年之后开启。”
“此处乃是海泽神国，乃是无尽海族栖息修炼的场所，但是海族始终供奉的海族神像，据说乃是上界遗留的宝物，其内有着一处海神宝藏的传说。”
“最后便是此处，这里是苍玄界灵眼汇聚之地，只不过其中有着极其磅礴的威压，即便是合体境的修士也难以靠近。”
顾擎天将三处地点都给顾云一一介绍完毕，以龙城顾家在苍玄界的势力，查到这些信息并不困难。
但是……顾云并不打算完全照办，这是最后打算。
content_en:
Including the pretty woman from before, almost all the female disciples looked at the man who walked out of the divine light with fascination.
The temperament is out of the dust, just like an immortal.
Gu Yun's supreme charm aura came into play at this moment, and these women were like those star-chasers in previous lives who saw their idols, filled with surging love.
【bite! The host completes the villain's act - arson of the heart (lv5), and obtains a villain value of 1000]
It is said that the first sight of Gu Yun is a mistake for life. I don’t know how many women will lose their pursuit and desire for men because of this. Gu Yun is indeed very consistent with the villain’s style.
Just imagine, when these women see their husbands in the future, they will often ask, how are you compared to God Son Gu Yun?
I think back then, I was lucky enough to observe the demeanor of the Son of God... I don't know how much family harmony it will affect. It is really a sin.
This is the fifth time that Gu Yun has triggered this achievement. He has harmed ten thousand female cultivators who are as beautiful as flowers and as pure as paper just by looking at him. He is really the biggest sinner in the world.
"It's so handsome... It's so handsome, as if it came out of a painting."
"Xiaofang, pinch me to see if I'm dreaming?"
In an instant, the venue became noisy. Countless female disciples screamed and screamed. What's more, their legs gave out and they knelt on the ground.
The male idols of the past are no longer worth mentioning now. There is only one firm belief left in everyone's hearts, and that is - His Highness the Son of God!
Gu Cang looked at the many tribesmen around him who had become strange, and felt helpless, because he himself had the urge to kneel down at this moment.
"Is this the Son of God in the upper world? Compared with him, I am like a firefly compared to the bright moon!"
The previous complacency had all disappeared the moment he saw Gu Yun.
Although Gu Yun did not show any cultivation, the terrifying aura and majestic pressure on his body had made all the young people present lose the courage to compare, even Gu Cang was no exception. He felt the strongest. The gap between himself and Gu Yun may be thousands of times greater than the gap between himself and other disciples of the clan.
He thought he was already a genius, but today he realized how shallow his understanding was.
"His Royal Highness the Son of God is here. The lower world is barren and we cannot hold the grandest welcome ceremony for His Highness the Son of God. Please don't blame His Highness the Son of God."
The ancestor of the Gu family slowly walked forward, knelt down respectfully, and saluted Gu Yun.
"That's Ancestor Gu Qingtian, a powerful combination who dominated the world five hundred years ago."
"Even the combined monks are groveling. Only the Son of God in the upper world can be treated like this..."
Countless disciples have followed the same example, and the ancestors have all knelt down. If these disciples are still standing, what does that mean?
"Get up." Gu Yun said calmly: "Does the Gu family know what I have done?"
Originally, when the Gu family members went down to the lower realm, they were supposed to seal their memories and cultivation, use the skills of the lower realm, their identities in the lower realm, and rely on the obsession in their hearts to defeat a group of enemies, and finally refine the origin of the world, break through the integration, and ascend to the upper realm.
But——
Under the joint pressure from the Lin family and the Supreme God Dynasty, the Gu family chose to compromise, and it became the current traveling version.
Of course, this is also the effect of Gu Yun's supreme charm aura. No matter the Gu family, Lin family or the Supreme God, the three forces do not want anything to happen to Gu Yun, but... the ancestral order cannot be violated, so in the end, the formality is retained and it is a formality.
Naturally, the Gu family in Longcheng also knew the purpose of Gu Yun's visit.
Gu Qingtian said slowly: "Following the master's instructions, the Gu family started searching everywhere in Cangxuan Realm a year ago, and finally found these three places with the highest possibility!"
As he spoke, he handed over a map.
There are three places circled with spiritual power on it.
"This place is called the Endless Volcano. Divine fire surges inside it all year round and has not been extinguished for millions of years. It is a place where fire cultivators from the Cangxuan Realm linger all year round. The power inside is extremely suitable for fire cultivators to practice."
"Countless people have rumored that there is an opportunity to enter the Dao Palace. The latest one will open in half a year."
"This is the Haize Kingdom, a place where the endless sea people live and practice. However, the sea god statue that the sea people always enshrine is said to be a treasure left behind by the upper world. There is a legend of a sea god's treasure inside."
"The last one is here. This is the place where the spiritual eyes of the Cangxuan Realm gather. However, it contains extremely majestic pressure. Even monks in the Fusion Realm can't get close to it."
Gu Qingtian introduced all three locations to Gu Yun one by one. With the power of the Gu family in Longcheng in the Cangxuan Realm, it was not difficult to find this information.
But... Gu Yun doesn't intend to completely comply. This is his final plan.
